Subject: Billing interop: Commit schedule, payee residency, and tax routing

Hi Olga / Ben —

Thanks for the redlines so far. Procurement has a couple of blocking asks before we can finalize:

1) Invoice payee: our AP team needs the option to receive invoices to Novacorp EU (Novacorp EMEA Ltd) for the purchased capacity (they will not accept invoices to the US entity).
2) VAT/withholding: we need to confirm whether Redwood will gross up or if Novacorp will perform withholding at source. If withholding is required, AP requests a stamped tax certificate attached to the order form.
3) Net terms: the SOW includes Net 30 but with the staged minimum commits we prefer Net 45 for the first tranche to align to our supplier cycles.

Can Redwood confirm if you can split invoicing by payee entity and produce the tax certificate for EU invoicing? If any of this requires a change to the order form language, please send a clean mark-up.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Marta
Finance Lead, Novacorp

Hi Marta —

Thanks — good questions and totally reasonable asks. Quick summary of what we can do and what we'll need Legal/Finance to align on:

- Split invoicing by payee: Yes, we can support invoicing to Novacorp EMEA Ltd for the quarterly min-commit tranches. We'll map each invoice to the paying entity in the order form appendix.

- VAT/withholding: Our standard position is customer responsibility for withholding where local law mandates. We can add a clause that Redwood will provide an invoice-level tax certificate (see attached example) and will cooperate on gross-up language if required as a commercial concession.

- Net terms: We can be flexible on the first tranche payment terms. Proposal: First tranche Net45, subsequent tranches Net30. This preserves Redwood cashflow while accommodating Novacorp's procurement cycle.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached a draft order form (Novacorp_OrderForm_v3.pdf) with an appendix table mapping invoice->payee for each tranche.
2) Ben / Kimberly — can Legal/Finance review the proposed appendix language and the tax/gross-up note below?
3) Marta — if that approach works, I'll prepare a DocuSign packet with the updated order form + tax certificate attachment.

Attachment: Novacorp_OrderForm_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,

Thanks Olga — I like this direction. A few internal notes for Legal redlines (Kimberly / Karthik):

- Please add a short appendix table: tranche -> invoice payee entity -> currency -> tax responsibility (simple matrix). That keeps the MSA clean and puts routing in the order form.
- For the tax language: propose these two options for the customer to choose (we'll present both to Novacorp):
  a) Customer bears withholding: Customer provides proof of withholding and Redwood issues credit for the withheld portion on next invoice.
  b) Redwood gross-up: Redwood invoices gross and customer pays gross amount; Redwood then issues refund/credit if tax authorities reimburse — (this is operationally awkward; prefer option a).
- Net terms: accept Olga's proposal (1st tranche Net45, subsequent Net30) but ensure activation fee (if any) is invoiced upfront and not part of tranche netting.

I'll flag the draft to Legal with request to fast-track (DEAL-77821). Also recommend adding a single DocuSign link to the related_links to make execution faster.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks team —

Reviewed the attached order form and the proposed appendix. Legal is comfortable with mapping the tranche->payee matrix in the order form appendix (keeps the MSA unchanged). A few edits we will apply in the redline:

- Tax / Withholding language: add a 1-sentence fallback that if withholding is applied by law, Customer shall provide evidence (tax receipt/stamped certificate) within 30 days and Redwood will apply a credit for the withheld amount on the next invoice. This keeps our accounting clean and is consistent with option (a) Ben outlined.
- Gross-up: we will not accept a standing gross-up obligation on Redwood. We can, however, include an optional gross-up by mutual agreement with a documented pre-approval process.
- Net terms: approve 1st tranche Net45, subsequent Net30. Add explicit callout that activation fee (if present) is invoiced immediately and not subject to tranche netting.
- Attachments: please include the Novacorp_tax_certificate.pdf in the DocuSign envelope so AP has immediate proof.

Olga — can you send the DocuSign packet after Ben updates the appendix (one clean version + one redline)? I'll aim to turn Legal comments around within 24 hours once I see Ben's update.
